browser.menu.title: More
browser.pick: Pick an element into the chat
browser.quote: Quote the selection into the chat
browser.toast.cleared: The agent browser's data has been cleared.
browser.sites.title: Allowed sites
browser.sites.desc: Which hosts the agent's browser may load. The built-in guard (loopback and private addresses) applies either way.
browser.sites.empty: No host listed — an allowlist with no host blocks every page.
browser.window.title: Browser
browser.actions.title: Page actions
browser.empty.title: No page here yet
browser.empty.hint: Type a URL above, or open one of your bookmarks below.
browser.elsewhere.window: This page is showing in its own window.
browser.elsewhere.dock: This page is showing in the panel's other dock.
browser.elsewhere.hint: A page can only be in one place at a time.
browser.pip.title: Picture in Picture
browser.pip.empty: Nothing to show — the tab is blank.
browser.bookmarks.name: Name
browser.bookmarks.emptyHint: Bookmarks appear here — click the bookmark icon in the address bar.
browser.profiles.clearDesc: Removes every cookie, Local Storage and IndexedDB entry in this profile, including anything imported. Its bookmarks are kept. Your own browser is untouched.
browser.profiles.switched: Profile changed — this session's tabs are reopening in it.
browser.profiles.settings.heading: Browser profiles
browser.profiles.settings.intro: Each profile keeps its own logins, cookies and bookmarks. A session uses its own profile, else its project's, else the default one.
browser.profiles.settings.unavailable: Browser profiles need the desktop app.
browser.profiles.settings.deleteDesc: This permanently wipes the profile's logins, cookies and bookmarks. Sessions and projects that use it fall back to the default profile.
browser.proxy.indicatorNoAddr: Proxy / VPN is on — click to change
browser.loadTimer.done: Last page load: {ms} ms (from load start until every frame finished)
browser.profiles.proxy.chipTitle: Only this profile's tabs go through this proxy
browser.profiles.proxy.note: A proxy (VPN) for this profile only — its tabs go through it, the rest of the machine does not. Only you can change it; agents can't.
browser.profiles.proxy.authHint: Stored in the OS keychain, never shown again. Leave empty if the proxy needs no login.
browser.profiles.proxy.authWillClear: Login will be removed on save
browser.profiles.proxy.socksNoAuth: SOCKS5 with username/password isn't supported by Chromium. Use an HTTP/HTTPS proxy for authenticated proxies, or a local SOCKS5 client without login.
browser.profiles.proxy.bypassHint: Hosts that skip the proxy (comma-separated). Local addresses always skip it.
browser.profiles.proxy.saved: Proxy saved — tabs of this profile switch over now.
browser.profiles.free.warning: Free proxies are run by unknown parties. HTTPS content stays encrypted, but they see every hostname you visit and can read or alter plain-HTTP pages. Logins and cookies are only protected by TLS — use a separate profile with no accounts signed in.
browser.profiles.free.refresh: Reload the list from the sources
browser.profiles.free.hint: Fetches public lists from ProxyScrape and Geonode, then tests the best candidates with a real tunnel handshake. Nothing is contacted until you press the button. Regions appear after the first search.
browser.profiles.free.blockedGoogleTitle: The proxy works but Google is unreachable through it — the exit is usually behind a censored network (e.g. China). Other sites may still load.
browser.profiles.free.err.tls-reset: Tunnel opened but the HTTPS connection was cut — the proxy's network blocks it or the proxy is broken
browser.profiles.free.err.tls-cert: Wrong HTTPS certificate — the proxy is decrypting traffic (unsafe)
browser.profiles.free.err.tls-timeout: Tunnel opened but HTTPS did not answer in time
browser.profiles.free.err.timeout: The proxy did not answer in time
browser.profiles.free.useNew: Create a separate profile and use it there
browser.profiles.free.appliedNew: Created profile “{name}” with the proxy. Switch the session to it via ⋯ → Profile.
browser.profiles.free.appliedHere: Applied {host} to this profile. Test it to confirm the exit IP.
browser.profiles.free.appliedElsewhere: Applied {host} to the new profile “{name}”. Switch the session to it via ⋯ → Profile, then test.
